description: You can trace the supplied expression trees through an environment-based evaluator.

steps.description: The classes record literals, operations, conditionals, local bindings, and variable references.
Literal cases return stored values and Var reads env. The binary case obtains two values and builds its operation dictionary before selecting an entry.
The remaining cases handle If and LetExpr. Each returns the result of a further eval_expr call.

steps.question: Which value for x does the first supplied program receive?

steps.description: The first supplied result is 14. Its input tree contains a comparison and two arithmetic branches.
The second tree introduces y before its conditional body. Its displayed result is also 14.

title: Read a value-producing tree walk
